<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The '''Masked Warrior''' is [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]]'s final champion, a fighter who hides his face behind a mask: he is Grandpa Gohan, Goku's grandfather. He is the semi-finalist of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], and the last of Baba's own fighters in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The Masked Warrior is the '''semi-finalist''' of Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament: you face him after the four contenders ([[Special:MyLanguage/Fangs the Vampire|Fangs the Vampire]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Invisible Man|Invisible Man]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Akkuman|Akkuman]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Mummy|Mummy]]) and before the champion, [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Goku|Kid Goku]]. Unlike the contenders, he doesn't get stronger from round to round. His default stats are:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:9--> Stage</translate> !! <translate><!--T:10--> Health / melee / ki</translate> !! <translate><!--T:11--> AI tier</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:12--> Semi-finalist</translate> || 280 / 26 / 20 || <translate><!--T:13--> Smart</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
'''Rapid Kicks:''' every so often the Masked Warrior teleports in front of you and lands a flurry of up to 9 quick kicks in about a second.

<!--T:17-->
He doesn't fly and has no ki attacks, so his ki damage goes unused. In the tournament he fights on the '''Smart''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest '''Baba's Fighters: The Masked Warrior''' (quest 28) has you defeat him at Fortuneteller Baba's Palace.
</translate>
